    claim: Require exactly one app Thing, thing.webapp, with a specification and artifact.webapp binding; require Purpose, Externals, Theory and ontology references. Reject dangling references or domain types incorrectly declared as independently realized Things

    ownerId: system.keep-in-touch
    subjectKind: system
    subjectId: system.keep-in-touch
    targetKind: model
    sourceRefs: [P1]
    gates: [submission, promotion]
    hooks: [hook.system.structure]

    title: Theory supports the Purpose
    claim: Require T1–T5 to link activities, intended outcomes, measures and limitations to P1. Model validation rejects missing measures or engagement substituted for wanted contact; pilot outcome hooks record support, challenge or unknown separately from conformance
    ownerKind: system
    ownerId: system.keep-in-touch
    subjectKind: system
    subjectId: system.keep-in-touch
    targetKind: model
    sourceRefs: [P1, T1, T2, T3, T4, T5]
    gates: [submission, promotion]
    hooks: [hook.system.purpose.model, hook.system.purpose.outcome]
  - id: C.system.topology
    title: Communication topology holds
    claim: Require two-endpoint pairs, one target per outgoing direct action, private incoming aggregation and disabled group scope. Model validation rejects recipient arrays or an enabled digest without an accepted publication contract; C.webapp.outgoing.single supplies implementation evidence

    ownerId: system.keep-in-touch
    subjectKind: system
    subjectId: system.keep-in-touch

    sourceRefs: [GD.connect]
    gates: [submission, promotion]
    hooks: [hook.system.topology, hook.system.topology.semantic]

    title: Autonomy is preserved
    claim: Require owner-only goals and notes, explicit consent, revocation and notification bounds across enabled scope. A coverage hook must resolve these obligations to C.webapp.private.owner, C.webapp.connection.consent, C.webapp.revocation.current and C.webapp.prompts.bounded
    ownerKind: system
    ownerId: system.keep-in-touch
    subjectKind: system
    subjectId: system.keep-in-touch
    targetKind: model
    sourceRefs: [P1, T4]
    gates: [submission, promotion]
    hooks: [hook.system.autonomy]

    title: Specification is ready to realize
    claim: Require every enabled specification requirement to resolve to a protected criterion and executable hook, with Kits and versions pinned. Excluded later modules do not block the core; an enabled module with missing contracts or hooks does
    ownerKind: system
    ownerId: system.keep-in-touch
    subjectKind: system
    subjectId: system.keep-in-touch
    targetKind: model
    gates: [submission, promotion]
    hooks: [hook.system.readiness]

    ownerKind: system
    ownerId: system.keep-in-touch
    subjectKind: system
    subjectId: system.keep-in-touch
    targetKind: model
    gates: [submission, promotion]
    hooks: [hook.system.promotion]
  - id: C.system.concurrency
    title: Concurrent work is surfaced before promotion
    claim: Concurrent candidates touching the same subjects, journeys or criteria are reported as file, soft-semantic or hard-semantic conflicts before any of them is promoted
    ownerKind: system
    ownerId: system.keep-in-touch
    subjectKind: system
    subjectId: system.keep-in-touch
    targetKind: model
    sourceRefs: []
    severity: soft
    gates: [submission, candidate, promotion]

files.description.yaml:
# spec §3 General Description
narrative: >-
  The main experience is a purposeful contacts app. People are the organizing unit. Each relationship has an
  owner-only intention such as “check in every two weeks” or “make room for a proper conversation monthly.”
  A calm Today view suggests a finite set of next actions. A user can act, log contact, snooze, pause or revise
  the goal. There are no streak penalties or public relationship scores.
features:
  - { id: GD.contacts, name: Private contacts, summary: Keep a private contact record before any friend installs the app; optional channel and context., source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "3" } }
  - { id: GD.goals, name: Cadence and depth, summary: An owner-only goal with an interval and a desired depth, with a schedule preview., source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "3" } }
  - { id: GD.connect, name: Consented pair connections, summary: Invitation-based pairs formed by two explicit consents; either party can disconnect or block., source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "3" } }
  - { id: GD.prompts, name: Suggested next actions, summary: A finite Today view of at most five due suggestions; opening a channel never completes a goal., source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "3" } }
  - { id: GD.updates, name: Digests and photo suggestions (later), summary: Later digests and photo suggestions; realization deferred while the digest interpretation is unresolved., deferred: true, source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "3" } }
commitments:
  - id: commitment.one-to-one
    statement: One-to-one actions - exactly one recipient per draft, send request or private reply; no recipient list, bulk send or group thread.
    features: [GD.connect, GD.prompts]
    coupledWith: [commitment.finite-incoming, commitment.owner-cadence, commitment.personal-initiation]
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "3" }
  - id: commitment.finite-incoming
    statement: A finite incoming view - Today returns at most five suggestions; many independent senders appear in one owner's finite inbox.
    features: [GD.prompts, GD.connect]
    coupledWith: [commitment.one-to-one, commitment.owner-cadence, commitment.personal-initiation]
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "3" }
  - id: commitment.owner-cadence
    statement: Owner-defined cadence and depth - goals are owner-only; depth labels are the owner's, not a global quality ranking.
    features: [GD.goals, GD.contacts]
    coupledWith: [commitment.one-to-one, commitment.finite-incoming, commitment.personal-initiation]
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "3" }
  - id: commitment.personal-initiation
    statement: Personal control over initiating contact - opening a channel needs a user gesture and never completes a goal; no autonomous send.
    features: [GD.prompts, GD.connect]
    coupledWith: [commitment.one-to-one, commitment.finite-incoming, commitment.owner-cadence]
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "3" }
  - id: commitment.no-engagement-mechanics
    statement: No streak penalties, public relationship scores or group discussion belong in the core contract.
    features: [GD.contacts, GD.goals, GD.connect, GD.prompts]
    coupledWith: [commitment.one-to-one, commitment.finite-incoming, commitment.owner-cadence, commitment.personal-initiation]
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "3" }
alternatives:
  - >-
    Reader-driven digest publication (proposed interpretation): an author publishes an owned edition and approved
    subscribers independently read it; replies remain one-to-one and readers cannot see or address one another.
  - >-
    Retain only individually addressed updates, if “no one-to-many outgoing” prohibits all shared digest visibility.
  - Shared intentions - two people agree on a joint contact rhythm as a new consented object that never exposes either private goal.
openQuestions:
  - >-
    Digest interpretation: this still distributes one author's information to many people. If “no one-to-many
    outgoing” prohibits all such visibility, shared digests conflict with it. Digest realization stays blocked
    until that interpretation is accepted.
  - Photo suggestions need a device capability adapter, local or provider processing and an approval contract before any upload or send.
  - Groups need their own Purpose, membership and topology contract and an accepted Evolution; disabled in this System.
  - Live messaging may need Durable Objects only if a later messaging Evolution requires coordinated live state.

files.externals.yaml:
# spec §2 Externals and boundary
externals:
  - id: ext.owner
    kind: person
    name: Owner
    modeled: The person using the app, their time zone, available attention, goals and accessibility needs
    external: Their attention, intentions and whether they respond; people control what a relationship means
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "2" }
  - id: ext.contacts
    kind: group
    name: Contacts
    modeled: Friends, family and other selected people; some have app accounts and some do not
    external: Whether and how they respond; what the relationship means to them
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "2" }
  - id: ext.relationship-context
    kind: context
    name: Relationship context
    modeled: Distance, changing routines, communication preferences and welcome or unwelcome contact; record uncertainty
    external: The real state of the relationship
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "2" }
  - id: ext.channels
    kind: service
    name: Channels
    modeled: Calls, meetings, SMS, email and other messaging apps
    external: The app cannot infer their delivery or meaning merely by opening them
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "2" }
  - id: ext.device
    kind: device
    name: Device
    modeled: Browser, device notification permissions and selected files; access to a phone gallery is a later capability
    external: Device capabilities and permissions granted by the owner
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "2" }
  - id: ext.providers
    kind: service
    name: Providers
    modeled: Identity, notification and optional model providers, including their limits and failures
    external: Provider availability, limits and failures
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "2" }
  - id: ext.events
    kind: event
    name: Events
    modeled: Changes in routines, travel, milestones and service outages relevant to contact; record source, time and uncertainty, without assuming access to private calendars
    external: The events themselves and the owner's private calendars
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "2" }

id: J.connect
name: Connect with someone through a consented invitation
actorGoal: Create a pair connection that both people explicitly consent to
features:
- GD.connect
requirements:
- S.webapp.authentication
- S.webapp.concurrency
- S.webapp.operations
start: s1
steps:
- id: s1
  actor: user
  action: Open Person and choose Invite
  kind: action
  screen: screen.person
  next:
  - to: s2
  requirementRefs:
  - S.webapp.screens
- id: s2
  actor: system
  action: 'Create invitation: 128-bit credential, only a token hash stored, expires in 24 hours, one acceptance'
  kind: action
  screen: screen.person
  operation: operation.invite.create
  next:
  - to: s3
  requirementRefs:
  - S.webapp.operations
- id: s3
  actor: user
  action: Share the invitation by QR or connection code through an outside channel
  kind: action
  external: ext.channels
  next:
  - to: s4
  requirementRefs:
  - S.webapp.operations
- id: s4
  actor: counterpart
  action: Open /connect/:token
  kind: branch
  screen: screen.invitation
  next:
  - to: s5
    when: token valid
  - to: f1
    when: token invalid, expired or used
  requirementRefs:
  - S.webapp.authentication
- id: s5
  actor: system
  action: Is the invitee signed in?
  kind: branch
  screen: screen.invitation
  next:
  - to: s7
    when: signed in
  - to: s6
    when: not signed in
  requirementRefs:
  - S.webapp.authentication
- id: s6
  actor: counterpart
  action: Sign in; the validated invitation is preserved and not consumed
  kind: action
  screen: screen.signin
  next:
  - to: s7
  requirementRefs:
  - S.webapp.authentication
- id: s7
  actor: counterpart
  action: See who is inviting; Accept or Decline
  kind: branch
  screen: screen.invitation
  next:
  - to: s8
    when: accept
  - to: e2
    when: decline
  requirementRefs:
  - S.webapp.operations
- id: s8
  actor: system
  action: Atomically consume the invite and create or return the unique active pair
  kind: branch
  operation: operation.invite.accept
  next:
  - to: e1
    when: pair created or returned
  - to: f2
    when: invitee is the inviter, or a block exists in either direction
  - to: s9
    when: another accept races for the same invite
  requirementRefs:
  - S.webapp.operations
  - S.webapp.concurrency
- id: s9
  actor: system
  action: 'Concurrent accept: one redemption wins, no second pair'
  kind: branch
  operation: operation.invite.accept
  next:
  - to: e1
    when: this request won
  - to: f1
    when: this request lost
  requirementRefs:
  - S.webapp.concurrency
- id: f1
  actor: system
  action: UnavailablePanel shown; no acceptance control
  kind: failure
  screen: screen.invitation
  next:
  - to: e3
    when: stop
  requirementRefs:
  - S.webapp.authentication
- id: f2
  actor: system
  action: Acceptance refused without revealing why
  kind: failure
  operation: operation.invite.accept
  next:
  - to: e3
    when: stop
  requirementRefs:
  - S.webapp.operations
- id: e1
  actor: system
  action: Connection active; both consents recorded; private goals and notes stay unshared
  kind: end
  next: []
  requirementRefs:
  - S.webapp.operations
- id: e2
  actor: counterpart
  action: Invitation declined; no pair created
  kind: end
  screen: screen.invitation
  next: []
  requirementRefs:
  - S.webapp.operations
- id: e3
  actor: counterpart
  action: No connection created
  kind: end
  next: []
  requirementRefs:
  - S.webapp.concurrency

    statement: >-
      Help an individual keep in touch with selected people at a personally meaningful frequency and depth,
      while respecting both people's autonomy.
    beneficiaries: [ext.owner, ext.contacts]
    intendedChange: >-
      More wanted contact and less effort remembering or initiating it.
    successCriteria:
      - More wanted contact happens with the people the owner chose to keep in touch with.
      - Less effort is needed to remember or initiate contact.
      - Both people's autonomy is respected; unwanted pressure does not rise.
    nonGoals:
      - Time spent in the app (diagnostic measure only)
      - Message volume (diagnostic measure only)
      - Notification opens (diagnostic measure only)
      - Streak penalties, public relationship scores and group discussion (spec §3)

      - Private contacts, goals and notes stay owner-only; connecting accounts adds consensual sharing capabilities and does not turn private notes or goals into shared data.

files.theory.yaml:
# spec §4 Theory and outcome Evaluation
# Protocol (applies to T1-T4): record a two-week personal baseline where the user chooses, then a four-week
# pilot. Compare descriptive trends and interview participants; missing baseline remains unknown. A
# before-and-after improvement cannot establish causality. Pilot targets are hypotheses: more goals met
# without increased reported burden. No invented numerical effect target.
claims:
  - id: T1
    name: Remembering
    purpose: P1
    mechanism: Private context and a chosen cadence reduce forgetting
    beneficiaries: [ext.owner]
    activities: [GD.contacts, GD.goals, GD.prompts]
    outcome: Wanted contact happens more reliably
    indicator: Weekly proportion of active goals satisfied by qualifying contact; denominator excludes paused goals
    evaluationMethod: >-
      Two-week personal baseline where the user chooses, then a four-week pilot; compare descriptive trends and
      interview participants. A later randomized or staggered comparison with consent and a defined outcome protocol can test T1-T3.
    limitation: >-
      Missing baseline remains unknown; a before-and-after improvement cannot establish causality; no numerical
      effect target is set. Does not assume more frequent contact always improves a relationship.
  - id: T2
    name: Initiating
    purpose: P1
    mechanism: One concrete next action lowers initiation effort
    beneficiaries: [ext.owner]
    activities: [GD.prompts]
    outcome: Initiating contact takes less effort
    indicator: User-rated effort before and after use
    evaluationMethod: >-
      Two-week personal baseline, then a four-week pilot; compare descriptive trends and interview participants.
    limitation: A channel opened is not proof that contact occurred; before-and-after change cannot establish causality.
  - id: T3
    name: Meaning
    purpose: P1
    mechanism: User-defined depth prompts help contact feel worthwhile
    beneficiaries: [ext.owner]
    activities: [GD.goals, GD.prompts]
    outcome: Contact feels more worthwhile
    indicator: Optional short reflection on meaningfulness
    evaluationMethod: >-
      Optional reflection collected during the four-week pilot against the two-week baseline; later randomized or
      staggered comparison with consent.
    limitation: Avoid treating a model's rating as relationship truth; missing baseline remains unknown.
  - id: T4
    name: Autonomy
    purpose: P1
    mechanism: Adjustable cadence, pauses and recipient consent reduce unwanted pressure
    beneficiaries: [ext.owner, ext.contacts]
    activities: [GD.goals, GD.connect, GD.prompts]
    outcome: Less unwanted pressure
    indicator: Notification burden, snoozes, opt-outs and private burden reports
    evaluationMethod: >-
      Four-week pilot with private burden reports against the two-week baseline; interview participants.
    limitation: Blocking is not a product failure; before-and-after change cannot establish causality.
  - id: T5
    name: Updates later
    purpose: P1
    mechanism: Consented digest reading provides context for a personal follow-up
    beneficiaries: [ext.owner, ext.contacts]
    activities: [GD.updates]
    outcome: Readers have context that supports a personal follow-up
    indicator: Reader usefulness and subsequent voluntary contact
    evaluationMethod: Deferred until the digest interpretation is accepted and the module is enabled.
    limitation: Passive reading never counts as personal contact by default.
    deferred: true

files.things/webapp/ontology.yaml:
# Nested ontology for thing.webapp. Sections, AppShell/TopBar/PrimaryNav/RouteOutlet, StatePanel, ErrorSummary,
# binding.worker, binding.scheduler and policy.authentication come from template.thing.cloudflare-worker-webapp@1
# and are not redeclared here; this file only adds links to them (e.g. policy.authentication governs the
# sign-in and invitation screens via `direction: in` links).
# Source: spec §6 "Screen and route" table (UI), §5 "Domain ontology" (entities), §6 "Operation" table
# (operations), §6 "Nested ontology navigation" (policies, bindings).
nodes:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- UI: screens (spec §6 screen table)
  - id: screen.signin
    kind: screen
    name: Sign in
    parent: section.ui
    route: /signin
    roles: [anonymous]
    states: [loaded, loading, error]
    description: One SignInForm with one Continue control and one privacy link; no private content
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }
    links:
      - { rel: serves, to: ext.owner }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.authentication, direction: in }
      - { rel: references, to: ext.providers, label: identity provider }
    children:
      - id: component.SignInForm
        kind: component
        name: SignInForm
        cardinality: exactly one
        description: One SignInForm
        source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }
        children:
          - id: component.SignInContinue
            kind: component
            name: Continue
            cardinality: exactly one
            description: One Continue control
            children:
              - id: affordance.SignInContinue.continue
                kind: affordance
                name: Continue
                actor: ext.owner
                trigger: Owner activates Continue
                preconditions: [Not signed in]
                effects:
                  - Starts sign-in with the pinned identity provider
                  - Login continuation preserves a validated invitation without consuming it
                failure: [Provider unavailable shows the shared ErrorSummary]
                source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }
                links:
                  - { rel: references, to: ext.providers }
      - id: component.PrivacyLink
        kind: component
        name: PrivacyLink
        cardinality: exactly one
        description: One privacy link

  - id: screen.today
    kind: screen
    name: Today
    parent: section.ui
    route: /today
    roles: [owner]
    states: [loaded, loading, empty, error]
    description: >-
      Exactly PageHeading, TodayControls and SuggestionCollection; 0–5 cards, or one EmptyState inside the collection.
      Each card has one person label, reason, Open person, Log contact and Snooze controls
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }
    links:
      - { rel: serves, to: ext.owner }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.ownerOnly, direction: in }
    children:
      - id: component.TodayHeading
        kind: component
        name: PageHeading
        cardinality: exactly one
      - id: component.TodayControls
        kind: component
        name: TodayControls
        cardinality: exactly one
      - id: component.SuggestionCollection
        kind: component
        name: SuggestionCollection
        cardinality: exactly one
        description: Today must return at most five suggestions, ordered by effective due date then stable goal ID
        links:
          - { rel: reads, to: entity.Suggestion }
        children:
          - id: component.SuggestionCard
            kind: component
            name: SuggestionCard
            cardinality: 0..5, one per open suggestion
            description: Each card has one person label, reason, Open person, Log contact and Snooze controls
            links:
              - { rel: reads, to: entity.Suggestion }
            children:
              - id: component.SuggestionPersonLabel
                kind: component
                name: PersonLabel
                cardinality: exactly one per card
              - id: component.SuggestionReason
                kind: component
                name: Reason
                cardinality: exactly one per card
              - id: affordance.SuggestionCard.openPerson
                kind: affordance
                name: Open person
                actor: ext.owner
                trigger: Owner activates Open person on a card
                preconditions: [Owned contact]
                effects: [Navigates to /people/:id for the suggestion's target ContactRecord]
                failure: [Contact not found shows a non-revealing denial]
              - id: affordance.SuggestionCard.logContact
                kind: affordance
                name: Log contact
                actor: ext.owner
                trigger: Owner activates Log contact on a card
                preconditions: [Owned contact]
                effects: [Navigates to /people/:id/log]
                failure: [Contact not found shows a non-revealing denial]
              - id: affordance.SuggestionCard.snooze
                kind: affordance
                name: Snooze
                actor: ext.owner
                trigger: Owner activates Snooze on a card
                preconditions: [Open suggestion for an enabled goal]
                effects:
                  - Snoozing must update its effective due date
                  - Cancels obsolete notification jobs for the snoozed suggestion
                failure: [Stale version returns conflict without overwriting current data]
                links:
                  - { rel: writes, to: entity.Suggestion }
                  # spec §5 puts "pause and snooze" on RelationshipGoal; §6 S.webapp.prompts: "Snoozing must update its effective due date"
                  - { rel: writes, to: entity.RelationshipGoal }
                  # Approximation: the spec defines no separate snooze operation, so goal.save carries the goal-version update.
                  - { rel: invokes, to: operation.goal.save }
          - id: component.EmptyState
            kind: component
            name: EmptyState
            cardinality: 1 only when there are no suggestions, inside the collection
            description: One EmptyState inside the collection

  - id: screen.people
    kind: screen
    name: People
    parent: section.ui
    route: /people
    roles: [owner]
    states: [loaded, loading, empty, error]
    description: >-
      Exactly PageHeading, SearchInput, AddContact control and ContactCollection. One ContactRow per result; each row
      has a name and Open control. One AddContactDialog only while invoked, with name, optional channel fields, Save and Cancel
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }
    links:
      - { rel: serves, to: ext.owner }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.ownerOnly, direction: in }
    children:
      - id: component.PeopleHeading
        kind: component
        name: PageHeading
        cardinality: exactly one
      - id: component.SearchInput
        kind: component
        name: SearchInput
        cardinality: exactly one
      - id: component.AddContact
        kind: component
        name: AddContact
        cardinality: exactly one
        description: AddContact control
        children:
          - id: affordance.AddContact.open
            kind: affordance
            name: Add contact
            actor: ext.owner
            trigger: Owner activates AddContact
            effects: [Opens the AddContactDialog; nothing is saved until Save]
            failure: []
      - id: component.ContactCollection
        kind: component
        name: ContactCollection
        cardinality: exactly one
        links:
          - { rel: reads, to: entity.ContactRecord }
        children:
          - id: component.ContactRow
            kind: component
            name: ContactRow
            cardinality: 1 per result
            description: One ContactRow per result; each row has a name and Open control
            links:
              - { rel: reads, to: entity.ContactRecord }
            children:
              - id: component.ContactRowName
                kind: component
                name: Name
                cardinality: exactly one per row
              - id: affordance.ContactRow.open
                kind: affordance
                name: Open
                actor: ext.owner
                trigger: Owner activates the row Open control
                preconditions: [Owned contact]
                effects: [Navigates to /people/:id]
                failure: [Another owner's record returns a non-revealing denial]
      - id: component.AddContactDialog
        kind: component
        name: AddContactDialog
        cardinality: 1 only while invoked
        states: [closed, open, validation-error, saving]
        description: One AddContactDialog only while invoked, with name, optional channel fields, Save and Cancel
        source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }
        children:
          - id: component.AddContactNameField
            kind: component
            name: NameField
            cardinality: exactly one
            description: Name field; nonblank name is required
          - id: component.AddContactChannelFields
            kind: component
            name: ChannelFields
            cardinality: optional
            description: Optional channel fields
          - id: affordance.AddContactDialog.save
            kind: affordance
            name: Save
            actor: ext.owner
            trigger: Owner activates Save in the dialog
            preconditions: [Owner session, Nonblank name]
            effects:
              - Save invokes operation.contact.save
              - Save only that owner's record; editing does not send invitations
            failure:
              - Validation failure keeps entered values and renders one ErrorSummary
              - Network error keeps entered values and renders one ErrorSummary
            source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }
            links:
              - { rel: invokes, to: operation.contact.save }
          - id: affordance.AddContactDialog.cancel
            kind: affordance
            name: Cancel
            actor: ext.owner
            trigger: Owner activates Cancel in the dialog
            effects: [Closes the dialog and discards the draft; nothing is saved]
            failure: []

  - id: screen.person
    kind: screen
    name: Person
    parent: section.ui
    route: /people/:id
    roles: [owner]
    states: [loaded, loading, error]
    description: >-
      Exactly PersonSummary, GoalPanel, ContactHistory, PrivateNotes, ConnectionPanel and ActionBar. History has one
      row per event. Actions are Edit goal, Log contact and Open channel; connection status determines Invite,
      Disconnect or Block availability
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }
    links:
      - { rel: serves, to: ext.owner }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.ownerOnly, direction: in }
    children:
      - id: component.PersonSummary
        kind: component
        name: PersonSummary
        cardinality: exactly one
        links:
          - { rel: reads, to: entity.ContactRecord }
      - id: component.GoalPanel
        kind: component
        name: GoalPanel
        cardinality: exactly one
        description: No saved goal displays as no goal, not as an inferred target
        links:
          - { rel: reads, to: entity.RelationshipGoal }
      - id: component.ContactHistory
        kind: component
        name: ContactHistory
        cardinality: exactly one
        links:
          - { rel: reads, to: entity.ContactEvent }
        children:
          - id: component.HistoryRow
            kind: component
            name: HistoryRow
            cardinality: 1 per event
            description: History has one row per event
      - id: component.PrivateNotes
        kind: component
        name: PrivateNotes
        cardinality: exactly one
        description: Owner-only notes; linking a ContactRecord to an Account never reveals them
        links:
          - { rel: reads, to: entity.ContactEvent }
      - id: component.ConnectionPanel
        kind: component
        name: ConnectionPanel
        cardinality: exactly one
        description: Connection status determines Invite, Disconnect or Block availability
        links:
          - { rel: reads, to: entity.Connection }
        children:
          - id: affordance.ConnectionPanel.invite
            kind: affordance
            name: Invite
            actor: ext.owner
            trigger: Owner activates Invite
            preconditions: [Contact is not connected, No block in either direction]
            effects: [Invokes operation.invite.create and shows the invitation QR or connection code]
            failure: [Not available when already connected or blocked]
            links:
              - { rel: invokes, to: operation.invite.create }
          - id: affordance.ConnectionPanel.disconnect
            kind: affordance
            name: Disconnect
            actor: ext.owner
            trigger: Owner confirms Disconnect
            preconditions: [Active Connection with this contact's linked account]
            effects: [Removes shared capabilities while private records remain under the owner's control]
            failure: [Not available when there is no active Connection]
            links:
              - { rel: invokes, to: operation.connection.revoke }
          - id: affordance.ConnectionPanel.block
            kind: affordance
            name: Block
            actor: ext.owner
            trigger: Owner confirms Block
            preconditions: [Contact is linked to an Account]
            effects:
              - A block prevents new app-mediated contact until removed
              - Pauses the blocker's corresponding goal and suppresses its suggestions
            failure: [Not available when the contact has no linked account]
            links:
              - { rel: invokes, to: operation.connection.revoke }
      - id: component.PersonActionBar
        kind: component
        name: ActionBar
        cardinality: exactly one
        description: Actions are Edit goal, Log contact and Open channel
        children:
          - id: affordance.PersonActionBar.editGoal
            kind: affordance
            name: Edit goal
            actor: ext.owner
            trigger: Owner activates Edit goal
            preconditions: [Owned contact]
            effects: [Navigates to /people/:id/goal]
            failure: []
          - id: affordance.PersonActionBar.logContact
            kind: affordance
            name: Log contact
            actor: ext.owner
            trigger: Owner activates Log contact
            preconditions: [Owned contact]
            effects: [Navigates to /people/:id/log]
            failure: []
          - id: affordance.PersonActionBar.openChannel
            kind: affordance
            name: Open channel
            actor: ext.owner
            trigger: A user gesture on Open channel
            preconditions: [Contact has a recorded channel or copyable contact details]
            effects:
              - Opening an external channel must require a user gesture
              - Opening a channel does not automatically mark contact as completed
              - Unsupported channels must offer copyable contact details
            failure: [Unsupported channel offers copyable contact details instead]
            source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }
            links:
              - { rel: references, to: ext.channels, label: opens the preferred channel }

  - id: screen.goal
    kind: screen
    name: Goal
    parent: section.ui
    route: /people/:id/goal
    roles: [owner]
    states: [loaded, loading, error, validation-error, no-goal]
    description: >-
      Exactly PageHeading, GoalForm and SchedulePreview. Form contains interval, depth, preferred channel and enabled
      controls, plus Save and Cancel. No saved goal displays as no goal, not as an inferred target
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }
    links:
      - { rel: serves, to: ext.owner }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.ownerOnly, direction: in }
    children:
      - id: component.GoalHeading
        kind: component
        name: PageHeading
        cardinality: exactly one
      - id: component.GoalForm
        kind: component
        name: GoalForm
        cardinality: exactly one
        description: Form contains interval, depth, preferred channel and enabled controls, plus Save and Cancel
        children:
          - id: component.GoalIntervalField
            kind: component
            name: IntervalField
            cardinality: exactly one
            description: intervalDays from 1 through 3650
          - id: component.GoalDepthField
            kind: component
            name: DepthField
            cardinality: exactly one
            description: desiredDepth in light, meaningful or shared-time
          - id: component.GoalChannelField
            kind: component
            name: PreferredChannelField
            cardinality: exactly one
          - id: component.GoalEnabledToggle
            kind: component
            name: EnabledToggle
            cardinality: exactly one
          - id: affordance.GoalForm.save
            kind: affordance
            name: Save
            actor: ext.owner
            trigger: Owner activates Save
            preconditions: [Owned contact, Valid interval]
            effects:
              - Invokes operation.goal.save
              - Increment goal version, recompute due state and cancel obsolete jobs
            failure:
              - Validation failure keeps entered values and renders one ErrorSummary
              - Stale version returns conflict
            links:
              - { rel: invokes, to: operation.goal.save }
          - id: affordance.GoalForm.cancel
            kind: affordance
            name: Cancel
            actor: ext.owner
            trigger: Owner activates Cancel
            effects: [Returns to /people/:id without saving]
            failure: []
      - id: component.SchedulePreview
        kind: component
        name: SchedulePreview
        cardinality: exactly one
        description: >-
          SchedulePreview must show that effect before saving. Changing depth may change which historical events qualify
        links:
          - { rel: reads, to: entity.RelationshipGoal }
          - { rel: reads, to: entity.ContactEvent }

  - id: screen.logContact
    kind: screen
    name: Log contact
    parent: section.ui
    route: /people/:id/log
    roles: [owner]
    states: [loaded, loading, error, validation-error, no-goal]
    description: >-
      Exactly PersonSummary and ContactEventForm. Form contains date and time, channel, depth, Met this goal checkbox,
      optional note, Save and Cancel. Met this goal defaults unchecked and is disabled when no current goal exists
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }
    links:
      - { rel: serves, to: ext.owner }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.ownerOnly, direction: in }
    children:
      - id: component.LogPersonSummary
        kind: component
        name: PersonSummary
        cardinality: exactly one
      - id: component.ContactEventForm
        kind: component
        name: ContactEventForm
        cardinality: exactly one
        children:
          - id: component.EventDateTimeField
            kind: component
            name: DateTimeField
            cardinality: exactly one
            description: Date and time; a nonfuture event time is required
          - id: component.EventChannelSelect
            kind: component
            name: ChannelSelect
            cardinality: exactly one
          - id: component.EventDepthSelect
            kind: component
            name: DepthSelect
            cardinality: exactly one
          - id: component.MetGoalCheckbox
            kind: component
            name: MetGoalCheckbox
            cardinality: exactly one
            states: [unchecked, checked, disabled]
            description: Met this goal defaults unchecked and is disabled when no current goal exists
          - id: component.EventNoteField
            kind: component
            name: NoteField
            cardinality: optional
            description: Optional private note
          - id: affordance.ContactEventForm.save
            kind: affordance
            name: Save
            actor: ext.owner
            trigger: Owner activates Save
            preconditions: [Owned contact, Nonfuture event time]
            effects:
              - Persist event; recompute affected goals without sending anything
              - A ContactEvent must qualify only when the owner explicitly marks that it met this goal
            failure:
              - Validation failure keeps entered values and renders one ErrorSummary
              - Stale version returns conflict
            links:
              - { rel: invokes, to: operation.contact.log }
          - id: affordance.ContactEventForm.cancel
            kind: affordance
            name: Cancel
            actor: ext.owner
            trigger: Owner activates Cancel
            effects: [Returns to /people/:id without saving]
            failure: []

  - id: screen.invitation
    kind: screen
    name: Invitation
    parent: section.ui
    route: /connect/:token
    roles: [invitee]
    states: [valid, invalid, expired, used, loading, error]
    description: >-
      Exactly InvitePreview and ConsentPanel after validation; Accept and Decline controls. Invalid, expired or used
      invitations show one UnavailablePanel and no acceptance control
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }
    links:
      - { rel: serves, to: ext.owner }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.authentication, direction: in }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.pairConsent, direction: in }
    children:
      - id: component.InvitePreview
        kind: component
        name: InvitePreview
        cardinality: exactly one after validation
        description: The recipient sees who is inviting them
        links:
          - { rel: reads, to: entity.ConnectionInvite }
      - id: component.ConsentPanel
        kind: component
        name: ConsentPanel
        cardinality: exactly one after validation
        children:
          - id: affordance.ConsentPanel.accept
            kind: affordance
            name: Accept
            actor: ext.owner
            trigger: Signed-in invitee activates Accept
            preconditions: [Signed-in distinct invitee, Valid unused credential, No block in either direction]
            effects:
              - Atomically consume invite and create or return the unique active pair
              - Creating the invitation and accepting it provide the two consents
            failure:
              - Invalid, expired or used invitations show one UnavailablePanel and no acceptance control
              - Concurrent accept yields one pair and one redemption
            links:
              - { rel: invokes, to: operation.invite.accept }
          - id: affordance.ConsentPanel.decline
            kind: affordance
            name: Decline
            actor: ext.owner
            trigger: Signed-in invitee activates Decline
            effects: [Leaves the invitation unaccepted; no pair is created]
            failure: []
      - id: component.UnavailablePanel
        kind: component
        name: UnavailablePanel
        cardinality: 1 only for invalid, expired or used invitations
        description: Invalid, expired or used invitations show one UnavailablePanel and no acceptance control

  - id: screen.settings
    kind: screen
    name: Settings
    parent: section.ui
    route: /settings
    roles: [owner]
    states: [loaded, loading, error]
    description: >-
      Exactly ProfilePreferences, NotificationPreferences, ExportControls and DeletionControls. Export and deletion
      act only on the authenticated owner's data
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }
    links:
      - { rel: serves, to: ext.owner }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.ownerOnly, direction: in }
    children:
      - id: component.ProfilePreferences
        kind: component
        name: ProfilePreferences
        cardinality: exactly one
        links:
          - { rel: reads, to: entity.Account }
      - id: component.NotificationPreferences
        kind: component
        name: NotificationPreferences
        cardinality: exactly one
        links:
          - { rel: reads, to: entity.Account }
      - id: component.ExportControls
        kind: component
        name: ExportControls
        cardinality: exactly one
        children:
          - id: affordance.ExportControls.export
            kind: affordance
            name: Export
            actor: ext.owner
            trigger: Owner reauthenticates and activates Export
            preconditions: [Owner reauthentication]
            effects: [Export authorized records of the authenticated owner only]
            failure: [Reauthentication failure denies the export]
            links:
              - { rel: invokes, to: operation.data.export }
      - id: component.DeletionControls
        kind: component
        name: DeletionControls
        cardinality: exactly one
        children:
          - id: affordance.DeletionControls.delete
            kind: affordance
            name: Delete account
            actor: ext.owner
            trigger: Owner reauthenticates and confirms deletion
            preconditions: [Owner reauthentication]
            effects: [Deletion revokes access immediately, cancels jobs and purges owned live data within seven days]
            failure: [Reauthentication failure denies the deletion]
            links:
              - { rel: invokes, to: operation.data.delete }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Domain: entities (spec §5 table)
  # "These are domain types and runtime records inside thing.webapp. They are not separate Things."
  - id: entity.Account
    kind: entity
    name: Account
    parent: section.domain
    description: ID, identity-provider subject, display name, time zone and notification preferences; one authenticated owner
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "5" }
    fields:
      - { name: id, type: string }
      - { name: identitySubject, type: string }
      - { name: displayName, type: string }
      - { name: timeZone, type: iana-time-zone }
      - { name: notificationPreferences, type: json }
    invariants: [One authenticated owner]
    links:
      - { rel: storedIn, to: binding.contactsStore }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.ownerOnly, direction: in }
  - id: entity.ContactRecord
    kind: entity
    name: ContactRecord
    parent: section.domain
    description: >-
      ID, ownerAccountId, display name, optional channels and linkedAccountId; belongs to one owner.
      A ContactRecord is a person's private representation of another person. Linking it to an Account does not
      transfer ownership or reveal notes
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "5" }
    fields:
      - { name: id, type: string }
      - { name: ownerAccountId, type: "ref:entity.Account" }
      - { name: displayName, type: string }
      - { name: channels, type: "list<json>", optional: true }
      - { name: linkedAccountId, type: "ref:entity.Account", optional: true }
      - { name: version, type: int }
    invariants:
      - Belongs to one owner
      - Owner-only
      - Linking to an Account does not transfer ownership or reveal notes
      - At most one linked contact per owner and counterpart account
    links:
      - { rel: storedIn, to: binding.contactsStore }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.ownerOnly, direction: in }
  - id: entity.ConnectionInvite
    kind: entity
    name: ConnectionInvite
    parent: section.domain
    description: ID, inviter, token hash, expiry and state; optional recipient binding; never contains login credentials
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "5" }
    fields:
      - { name: id, type: string }
      - { name: inviterAccountId, type: "ref:entity.Account" }
      - { name: tokenHash, type: string }
      - { name: expiresAt, type: timestamp }
      - { name: state, type: "enum pending|accepted|expired|revoked" }
      - { name: boundAccountId, type: "ref:entity.Account", optional: true }
    invariants:
      - Never contains login credentials
      - Stores only a token hash
      - Allows one successful acceptance
    links:
      - { rel: storedIn, to: binding.contactsStore }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.pairConsent, direction: in }
  - id: entity.Connection
    kind: entity
    name: Connection
    parent: section.domain
    description: ID, two distinct account IDs in canonical order, acceptance provenance and state; at most one active pair
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "5" }
    fields:
      - { name: id, type: string }
      - { name: firstAccountId, type: "ref:entity.Account" }
      - { name: secondAccountId, type: "ref:entity.Account" }
      - { name: acceptanceProvenance, type: json }
      - { name: state, type: "enum active|disconnected|blocked" }
    invariants:
      - Exactly two distinct accounts in a connected pair; a user may have many independent pairs
      - Account IDs in canonical order
      - At most one active pair
    links:
      - { rel: storedIn, to: binding.contactsStore }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.pairConsent, direction: in }
  - id: entity.Block
    kind: entity
    name: Block
    parent: section.domain
    description: Blocker and blocked account IDs; overrides connection, sharing and subscription permissions
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "5" }
    fields:
      - { name: blockerAccountId, type: "ref:entity.Account" }
      - { name: blockedAccountId, type: "ref:entity.Account" }
    invariants: [Overrides connection, sharing and subscription permissions]
    links:
      - { rel: storedIn, to: binding.contactsStore }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.revocation, direction: in }
  - id: entity.RelationshipGoal
    kind: entity
    name: RelationshipGoal
    parent: section.domain
    description: ID, owner, ContactRecord, intervalDays, desiredDepth, channel, anchorDate, pause and snooze; owner-only
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "5" }
    fields:
      - { name: id, type: string }
      - { name: ownerAccountId, type: "ref:entity.Account" }
      - { name: contactRecordId, type: "ref:entity.ContactRecord" }
      - { name: intervalDays, type: "int 1..3650" }
      - { name: desiredDepth, type: "enum light|meaningful|shared-time" }
      - { name: channel, type: string, optional: true }
      - { name: anchorDate, type: local-date }
      - { name: pausedAt, type: timestamp, optional: true }
      - { name: snoozedUntil, type: local-date, optional: true }
      - { name: version, type: int }
    invariants:
      - Owner-only
      - At most one current goal per owned contact
      - Goal is never exposed to its contact
    links:
      - { rel: storedIn, to: binding.contactsStore }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.ownerOnly, direction: in }
  - id: entity.ContactEvent
    kind: entity
    name: ContactEvent
    parent: section.domain
    description: ID, owner, ContactRecord, time, channel, self-reported depth and optional private note; one contact target
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "5" }
    fields:
      - { name: id, type: string }
      - { name: ownerAccountId, type: "ref:entity.Account" }
      - { name: contactRecordId, type: "ref:entity.ContactRecord" }
      - { name: occurredAt, type: timestamp }
      - { name: channel, type: string }
      - { name: selfReportedDepth, type: "enum light|meaningful|shared-time" }
      - { name: privateNote, type: string, optional: true }
      - { name: qualifiedGoalId, type: "ref:entity.RelationshipGoal", optional: true }
      - { name: qualifiedDepth, type: "enum light|meaningful|shared-time", optional: true }
    invariants:
      - One contact target
      - Qualifies only when the owner explicitly marks that it met this goal
      - Records the goal ID and desiredDepth at confirmation
    links:
      - { rel: storedIn, to: binding.contactsStore }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.ownerOnly, direction: in }
  - id: entity.Suggestion
    kind: entity
    name: Suggestion
    parent: section.domain
    description: ID, goal version, reason, due date, target ContactRecord and state; does not itself contact anybody
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "5" }
    fields:
      - { name: id, type: string }
      - { name: goalId, type: "ref:entity.RelationshipGoal" }
      - { name: goalVersion, type: int }
      - { name: reason, type: string }
      - { name: dueDate, type: local-date }
      - { name: targetContactRecordId, type: "ref:entity.ContactRecord" }
      - { name: state, type: "enum open|resolved|snoozed|suppressed" }
    invariants:
      - Does not itself contact anybody
      - At most one open suggestion per goal version and due cycle
    links:
      - { rel: storedIn, to: binding.contactsStore }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.ownerOnly, direction: in }
  - id: entity.NotificationJob
    kind: entity
    name: NotificationJob
    parent: section.domain
    description: ID, owner, suggestion and preference version, scheduled time, delivery state and deduplication key
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "5" }
    fields:
      - { name: id, type: string }
      - { name: ownerAccountId, type: "ref:entity.Account" }
      - { name: suggestionId, type: "ref:entity.Suggestion" }
      - { name: preferenceVersion, type: int }
      - { name: scheduledAt, type: timestamp }
      - { name: deliveryState, type: "enum scheduled|delivered|cancelled|failed" }
      - { name: dedupKey, type: string }
    invariants:
      - Delivery rechecks preferences and cancellations
      - One owner notification per local day containing a link without contact details
      - Queue bodies carry minimal IDs, not private relationship notes
    links:
      - { rel: storedIn, to: binding.contactsStore }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.ownerOnly, direction: in }
      - { rel: triggers, to: ext.providers, label: optional external reminder }
  # --- provisional (later) entities, spec §5 "later" rows
  - id: entity.MessageDraft
    kind: entity
    name: MessageDraft
    parent: section.domain
    provisional: true
    description: ID, author, exactly one recipient, body, approved attachments and state; no autonomous send
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "5" }
    fields:
      - { name: id, type: string }
      - { name: authorAccountId, type: "ref:entity.Account" }
      - { name: recipientAccountId, type: "ref:entity.Account" }
      - { name: body, type: string }
      - { name: approvedAttachments, type: "list<ref:entity.MediaAsset>", optional: true }
      - { name: state, type: string }
    invariants: [Exactly one recipient, No autonomous send]
  - id: entity.DigestEdition
    kind: entity
    name: DigestEdition
    parent: section.domain
    provisional: true
    description: ID, author, content version, publication time and access policy; no shared discussion thread
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "5" }
    fields:
      - { name: id, type: string }
      - { name: authorAccountId, type: "ref:entity.Account" }
      - { name: contentVersion, type: int }
      - { name: publishedAt, type: timestamp }
      - { name: accessPolicy, type: json }
    invariants: [No shared discussion thread, Immutable publication timestamp]
  - id: entity.Subscription
    kind: entity
    name: Subscription
    parent: section.domain
    provisional: true
    description: Subscriber, author, approval, start time and state; directed and independently revocable
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "5" }
    fields:
      - { name: subscriberAccountId, type: "ref:entity.Account" }
      - { name: authorAccountId, type: "ref:entity.Account" }
      - { name: approval, type: json }
      - { name: startsAt, type: timestamp }
      - { name: state, type: string }
    invariants: [Directed and independently revocable, Subscription does not imply reciprocal subscription]
  - id: entity.MediaAsset
    kind: entity
    name: MediaAsset
    parent: section.domain
    provisional: true
    description: ID, owner, private object key, permission provenance, retention and per-resource access grants
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "5" }
    fields:
      - { name: id, type: string }
      - { name: ownerAccountId, type: "ref:entity.Account" }
      - { name: privateObjectKey, type: string }
      - { name: permissionProvenance, type: json }
      - { name: retention, type: json }
    invariants: [Private bucket only, No permanent public media URL]

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Domain: operations (spec §6 operation table)
  - id: operation.contact.save
    kind: operation
    name: Create or edit private contact
    parent: section.domain
    description: Owner session; nonblank name. Save only that owner's record; editing does not send invitations
    preconditions: [Owner session, Nonblank name]
    effects: [Save only that owner's record; editing does not send invitations, Creation must return an immutable ID and version]
    failure: [Reads and writes to another owner's private records return a non-revealing denial, Concurrent stale-version edits return conflict without overwriting current data]
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }
    links:
      - { rel: writes, to: entity.ContactRecord }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.ownerOnly, direction: in }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.authentication, direction: in } # S.webapp.operations: mutations authorize the authenticated owner
  - id: operation.goal.save
    kind: operation
    name: Save goal
    parent: section.domain
    description: Owned contact and valid interval. Increment goal version, recompute due state and cancel obsolete jobs
    preconditions: [Owned contact, Valid interval]
    effects: [Increment goal version, Recompute due state, Cancel obsolete jobs, Revising a goal must not create a ContactEvent]
    failure: [Invalid interval is rejected with a validation error, Stale version returns conflict]
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }
    links:
      - { rel: reads, to: entity.ContactRecord }
      - { rel: writes, to: entity.RelationshipGoal }
      - { rel: writes, to: entity.Suggestion }
      - { rel: writes, to: entity.NotificationJob }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.ownerOnly, direction: in }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.authentication, direction: in } # S.webapp.operations: mutations authorize the authenticated owner
  - id: operation.contact.log
    kind: operation
    name: Log or revise contact
    parent: section.domain
    description: Owned contact, nonfuture event time. Persist event; recompute affected goals without sending anything
    preconditions: [Owned contact, Nonfuture event time]
    effects: [Persist event, Recompute affected goals without sending anything, Logging qualifying contact resolves its suggestion]
    failure: [Future event time is rejected, Stale version returns conflict]
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }
    links:
      - { rel: reads, to: entity.RelationshipGoal }
      - { rel: writes, to: entity.ContactEvent }
      - { rel: writes, to: entity.Suggestion }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.ownerOnly, direction: in }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.authentication, direction: in } # S.webapp.operations: mutations authorize the authenticated owner
  - id: operation.invite.create
    kind: operation
    name: Create invite
    parent: section.domain
    description: Authenticated inviter. Generate at least 128 bits of randomness, store only a token hash, expire after 24 hours and allow one successful acceptance
    preconditions: [Authenticated inviter]
    effects: [Generate at least 128 bits of randomness, Store only a token hash, Expire after 24 hours, Allow one successful acceptance]
    failure: [Unauthenticated inviter is denied, Blocked pair is refused]
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }
    links:
      - { rel: writes, to: entity.ConnectionInvite }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.pairConsent, direction: in }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.authentication, direction: in } # S.webapp.operations: mutations authorize the authenticated owner
  - id: operation.invite.accept
    kind: operation
    name: Accept invite
    parent: section.domain
    description: Signed-in distinct invitee, valid unused credential, no block in either direction. Atomically consume invite and create or return the unique active pair
    preconditions: [Signed-in distinct invitee, Valid unused credential, No block in either direction]
    effects: [Atomically consume invite and create or return the unique active pair]
    failure:
      - Invalid, expired or used credential is refused
      - Self-connection is refused
      - Block in either direction is refused
      - Two concurrent accept requests yield neither two pairs nor two redemptions
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }
    links:
      - { rel: reads, to: entity.Block }
      - { rel: writes, to: entity.ConnectionInvite }
      - { rel: writes, to: entity.Connection }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.pairConsent, direction: in }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.authentication, direction: in } # S.webapp.operations: mutations authorize the authenticated owner
  - id: operation.connection.revoke
    kind: operation
    name: Disconnect or block
    parent: section.domain
    description: Participant authority. Revoke affected app sharing and cancel pending deliveries; a block prevents new app-mediated contact until removed
    preconditions: [Participant authority]
    effects: [Revoke affected app sharing, Cancel pending deliveries, A block prevents new app-mediated contact until removed, Blocking pauses the blocker's corresponding goal]
    failure: [Non-participant is denied, Already delivered external messages or copied data cannot be retracted]
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }
    links:
      - { rel: writes, to: entity.Connection }
      - { rel: writes, to: entity.Block }
      - { rel: writes, to: entity.NotificationJob }
      # S.webapp.prompts: "Blocking a linked counterpart must pause the blocker's corresponding goal and suppress its suggestions"
      - { rel: writes, to: entity.RelationshipGoal }
      - { rel: writes, to: entity.Suggestion }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.revocation, direction: in }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.authentication, direction: in } # S.webapp.operations: mutations authorize the authenticated owner
  - id: operation.data.export
    kind: operation
    name: Export
    parent: section.domain
    description: Owner reauthentication. Export authorized records
    preconditions: [Owner reauthentication]
    effects: [Export authorized records, Export excludes other people's data]
    failure: [Reauthentication failure denies the export]
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }
    links:
      - { rel: reads, to: entity.ContactRecord }
      - { rel: reads, to: entity.RelationshipGoal }
      - { rel: reads, to: entity.ContactEvent }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.ownerOnly, direction: in }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.authentication, direction: in } # S.webapp.operations: mutations authorize the authenticated owner
  - id: operation.data.delete
    kind: operation
    name: Delete
    parent: section.domain
    description: Owner reauthentication. Deletion revokes access immediately, cancels jobs and purges owned live data within seven days. Backup expiry follows a pinned retention policy disclosed separately
    preconditions: [Owner reauthentication]
    effects: [Revoke access immediately, Cancel jobs, Purge owned live data within seven days, Backup expiry follows a pinned retention policy disclosed separately]
    failure: [Reauthentication failure denies the deletion]
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }
    links:
      - { rel: writes, to: entity.Account }
      - { rel: writes, to: entity.ContactRecord }
      - { rel: writes, to: entity.NotificationJob }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.ownerOnly, direction: in }
      - { rel: governs, to: policy.authentication, direction: in } # S.webapp.operations: mutations authorize the authenticated owner

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Authorization: policies (spec §6 navigation, §7)
  # policy.authentication comes from the Thing template (provisional until an auth Kit is pinned).
  - id: policy.ownerOnly
    kind: policy
    name: Owner-only access
    parent: section.authorization
    mode: owner-only
    description: Owner-only access to private contacts, goals, notes and logs; another owner's records return a non-revealing denial
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }
  - id: policy.pairConsent
    kind: policy
    name: Pair consent
    parent: section.authorization
    mode: pair-consent
    description: Explicit pair consent - creating the invitation and accepting it provide the two consents; an active pair is created once
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }
  - id: policy.revocation
    kind: policy
    name: Current revocation
    parent: section.authorization
    mode: revocation
    description: Read and send authorization must check revocation against current authoritative state; a block overrides connection and sharing
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Template shell links (nodes come from the template)
  # S.webapp.screens: "PrimaryNav must contain Today, People and Settings"
  - id: component.PrimaryNav
    kind: component
    name: PrimaryNav
    parent: component.AppShell
    owningThing: thing.webapp
    description: Primary navigation containing Today, People and Settings
    links:
      - { rel: references, to: screen.today }
      - { rel: references, to: screen.people }
      - { rel: references, to: screen.settings }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------- Runtime: binding (spec §6, §8)
  # Template ids binding.worker and binding.scheduler are inherited. The template's provisional binding.d1 placeholder
  # stays as shipped; the intended D1 binding for this Thing is binding.contactsStore.
  - id: binding.d1
    kind: binding
    name: D1 database
    parent: section.runtime
    owningThing: thing.webapp
    provisional: true
    description: Template placeholder, superseded by binding.contactsStore
  - id: binding.contactsStore
    kind: binding
    name: contactsStore (D1)
    parent: section.runtime
    description: runtime.contactsStore as the intended D1 binding for accounts, owned contacts, goals, events, consent and jobs; foreign keys, unique pair keys and conditional writes enforce structure
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "8" }
    links:
      - { rel: dependsOn, to: ext.providers, label: Cloudflare is provider context }

# spec §6 Specification for the webapp Thing (spec.webapp.core). Normative text quoted from the source document.
requirements:
  - id: S.webapp.scope
    thing: thing.webapp
    title: Core scope
    text: >-
      the app must provide private contacts, goals, contact logging, invitation-based pair connections, in-app due
      prompts and settings. Direct in-app messaging, subscriptions, digests, media automation and groups must remain
      disabled in the core scope. Opening an external channel must require a user gesture; unsupported channels must
      offer copyable contact details.
    refines: [GD.contacts, GD.goals, GD.connect, GD.prompts]
    subjects: [thing.webapp, affordance.PersonActionBar.openChannel]
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }
  - id: S.webapp.qualification
    thing: thing.webapp
    title: Goal qualification
    text: >-
      an enabled goal must have intervalDays from 1 through 3650 and desiredDepth in light, meaningful or shared-time.
      These are the owner's labels, not a global quality ranking. A ContactEvent must qualify only when the owner
      explicitly marks that it met this goal. The app must record the goal ID and desiredDepth at confirmation and
      count only qualifications matching the current desiredDepth. Changing depth may change which historical events
      qualify; SchedulePreview must show that effect before saving. Editing or deleting an event must recompute the schedule.
    refines: [GD.goals, GD.prompts]
    subjects: [entity.RelationshipGoal, entity.ContactEvent, component.SchedulePreview, operation.contact.log]
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }
  - id: S.webapp.due
    thing: thing.webapp
    title: Due dates
    text: >-
      the app must use local calendar dates in the owner's IANA time zone. The anchor must be the latest qualifying
      event date, or the goal creation date when none exists. dueDate must equal anchor plus intervalDays. A goal must
      become due when today's date reaches dueDate, unless paused or snoozed until a later date. Revising a goal must
      not create a ContactEvent. Date and time-zone fixtures must cover daylight-saving changes.
    refines: [GD.goals, GD.prompts]
    subjects: [entity.RelationshipGoal, entity.Suggestion, operation.goal.save]
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }
  - id: S.webapp.prompts
    thing: thing.webapp
    title: Today prompts
    text: >-
      Today must return at most five suggestions, ordered by effective due date then stable goal ID. There must be at
      most one open suggestion per goal version and due cycle. Logging qualifying contact must resolve its suggestion.
      Snoozing must update its effective due date; pausing must suppress prompts. Blocking a linked counterpart must
      pause the blocker's corresponding goal and suppress its suggestions. In-app reminders are required. Optional
      external reminders, when enabled, must be limited to one owner notification per local day containing a link
      without contact details. Reminder delivery must recheck preferences and cancellations.
    refines: [GD.prompts]
    subjects: [screen.today, entity.Suggestion, entity.NotificationJob]
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }
  - id: S.webapp.screens
    thing: thing.webapp
    title: Screens
    text: >-
      authenticated screens must share one AppShell containing exactly TopBar, PrimaryNav and RouteOutlet. PrimaryNav
      must contain Today, People and Settings. Counts below specify required RouteOutlet composition, excluding the
      shell. All private screens must show one StatePanel for loading or fatal error in place of loaded content. Forms
      must keep entered values after recoverable validation or network errors and render one ErrorSummary when needed.
    refines: [GD.contacts, GD.goals, GD.connect, GD.prompts]
    subjects: [screen.signin, screen.today, screen.people, screen.person, screen.goal, screen.logContact, screen.invitation, screen.settings]
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }
  - id: S.webapp.authentication
    thing: thing.webapp
    title: Authentication
    text: >-
      sensitive token routes must not leak tokens through analytics or referrers. Login continuation must preserve a
      validated invitation without consuming it. A pinned authentication Kit must specify the identity provider and
      its callback routes before realization.
    refines: [GD.connect]
    subjects: [screen.signin, screen.invitation, policy.authentication]
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }
  - id: S.webapp.operations
    thing: thing.webapp
    title: Operations
    text: >-
      all mutations must authorize the authenticated owner or explicit connected capability at the server, validate
      inputs and support an idempotency key. Creation must return an immutable ID and version. Reads and writes to
      another owner's private records must return a non-revealing denial. Concurrent stale-version edits must return
      conflict without overwriting current data. Each operation row below defines required preconditions and effects.
    refines: [GD.contacts, GD.goals, GD.connect]
    subjects:
      - operation.contact.save
      - operation.goal.save
      - operation.contact.log
      - operation.invite.create
      - operation.invite.accept
      - operation.connection.revoke
      - operation.data.export
      - operation.data.delete
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }
  - id: S.webapp.concurrency
    thing: thing.webapp
    title: Concurrency and revocation
    text: >-
      invite redemption must survive two concurrent accept requests without two pairs or two redemptions. Read and
      send authorization must check revocation against current authoritative state. Already delivered external
      messages or copied data remain outside our ability to retract.
    refines: [GD.connect]
    subjects: [operation.invite.accept, entity.Connection, policy.revocation]
    source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }
